name: Time picker
purpose: Payments scheduling: an Input-fields boxed field (free 24-hour HH:MM typing, validates on blur) plus a listbox of 30-minute slots opened from the time tail button — Dropdown's list language, scrolled to the chosen or nearest slot. Itinerary row 16 (P1); built Phase-2 wave 2 (worker A continuation).

props.name: value
props.$note: HH:MM 24-hour. Free typing accepts any valid minute (14:37); the list offers the 48 half-hour slots.

props.name: step
props.$note: Slot interval in minutes (30 = the reference; 15 doubles the list).
props.$status: s142-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-10) class C11 -- non-visual:binds-irrelevant. Non-visual -- composition/behavioural concern; binds do not apply. Record: reviews/BINDS-AUTHORING-VERDICTS-2026-08-10-s142-v3.json.

props.name: help
props.$note: '24-hour format, like 14:30.' — the format hint doubles as the 3.3.3 suggestion.

variants.name: closed
variants.use: Resting field with the time tail glyph.

variants.name: open
variants.use: Anchored listbox (~5.5 rows, scrolls): 44px options, tabular figures so the column aligns, selected = weight 500 + neutral tick.

Dropdown (listbox language: menu chrome, 44px options, weight+tick selection — change it there)

tokens.list: background/default + elevation/border + elevation/functional; border-radius/surface; hover = form/background/hover
tokens.selection: weight 500 + the neutral bespoke tick (icon/default stroke) — Dropdown precedent; list selection ≠ grid selection (Date-picker's ink knockout is the GRID treatment)
tokens.$input-error-slot: OPEN (ADR-0010): still undeclared — binds semantic rag/error (A-Q2).

behaviour.fallback: The text input works as a native field (HH:MM typed by hand); the tail button does nothing and the list never opens; no on-blur validation message.

$note.open: Tail button only (aria-haspopup=listbox); opening scrolls the selected — else nearest-to-now — slot to centre and focuses it. Typing NEVER opens the list (acd-019).
$note.keyboard: ArrowUp/Down move, Home/End jump, Enter/Space selects, Escape closes and returns focus to the tail button.
$note.select: Writes HH:MM, clears any error, closes, returns focus.
$note.validation: On blur: empty = no error; malformed or impossible times (25:70) error with 'Enter a time in 24-hour format, like 14:30.' Error lifts as soon as the value re-validates.

accessibility.structure: Real <label for>; input = role=combobox with aria-expanded/aria-controls; list = role=listbox of role=option items; help + message via aria-describedby.
accessibility.states: aria-selected on the chosen slot (the tick + weight are never the only channel); aria-invalid + ink message on error (1.4.1).
accessibility.focus: Two-tier focus (Input-fields decision B); option ring inset (Dropdown precedent); focus returns to the tail button on close.
accessibility.$note: 3.2.1/3.2.2 met (list opens from the button only) but out of relatedSC: not in the compliance lookup (Form-layout precedent).

antiPatterns: 12-hour AM/PM entry for payments (24-hour is the banking reference; ambiguity costs money).
type="time" native input (unstylable, inconsistent AT/format behaviour — text + inputmode=numeric).
Auto-inserting the colon mid-entry (acd-019: no auto-anything; validate on blur).
Opening the list on input focus (context change — tail button only).
Proportional figures in the slot column (tabular .t-cm-figure-5 — the column must align).
Ink-knockout selection in the list (that's the GRID treatment; lists = Dropdown's weight + tick).
